purpose: one recipe for every arm, so a cached R0 and a freshly inferred R5 are comparable
canonical_recipe_source: challenge/evaluation_v2/paper_real_eval.py and the R0 selector diagnostic's inference_recipe block

recipe.unpad_rule: subtract pad from box and keypoint coordinates after inference

why_raw_2d_is_stored: the 2D prediction stays the source of truth so the evaluator can be re-verified later without re-running any model
